name: Fury Walker
text: Member of the Fury Walkers: help and support in Bloodwood Village at any time. Easily befriend any manticore except Crimson Claws. In Bloodwood Village you can regularly get a few doses of medicine with the Rage Suppressant augment (marque up to the narrator).

name: Crimson Claw
text: Path of bloodlust and violent independence. You may willingly fail any resist against provocation, and you take −3 on such resists if you roll. You must resist the Rage Suppressant and Slow Heart medicine augments as if they were poisons.

name: Walks with the Furious
text: Not a manticore, but trusted and allowed into Bloodwood Village. Fury Walkers and many other sane non-Crimson-Claw manticores recognise you as a friend of their people.
